description: Defines the ProductImage class representing product images in the sales management system, including properties like image path, default status, type, cropping, and associations to products and descriptions.

classes.name: ProductImage
classes.description: Entity class representing a product image with metadata such as image path, type, default status, cropping, and links to product and descriptions.

methods.name: ProductImage
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a new ProductImage instance.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Returns the path or identifier for the stored product image.

methods.name: setProductImage
methods.description: Sets the path or identifier for the stored product image.

methods.name: isDefaultImage
methods.description: Checks if this image is marked as the default image for the product.

methods.name: setDefaultImage
methods.description: Sets whether this image is the default image.

methods.name: isImageCrop
methods.description: Checks if the image has been marked for cropping.

methods.name: setImageCrop
methods.description: Marks whether the image should be cropped.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the image, inherited from the base entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the image, inherited from the base entity.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product associated with this image.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates this image with a specific product.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the image.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of descriptions associated with this image.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image input stream, marked as transient.
